※ Pre-order bonus: by June 25th, 2021 ・GGST Sol & Ky special color set [Game Contents] “Guilty Gear -Strive-“ is the latest entry in the critically acclaimed Guilty Gear fighting game franchise.

Created by Daisuke Ishiwatari and developed by Arc System Works, “Guilty Gear -Strive-“  upholds the series’ reputation for groundbreaking hybrid 2D/3D cell-shaded graphics and intense, rewarding gameplay.
There is a fully voiced story mode diving deep into the Guilty Gear universe, new characters joining fan favorites, and robust rollback net code.
